description: This PHP class 'InterviewAttachmentDecorator' acts as a decorator for the 'InterviewAttachment' entity, providing methods to retrieve file content and associate an interview by ID. It includes traits for ORM helper functions and manages attachment data extraction.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for InterviewAttachment entity, adds methods for handling file content and linking interviews.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an InterviewAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the file content as a string, reading from resource if necessary.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying InterviewAttachment entity.

methods.name: setInterviewById
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with this attachment by ID.
